text: On XC7S50 conv2d, when the 84.95 MHz limit is the unregistered 11.75 ns DSP path (4.01 ns DSP48E1 M->P plus ~5 levels of 28-bit carry-chain adds), register the DSP I/M/P (dsp_regs=in_pipe_out), set pipe_mul=2 and tree_regs=3, and shrink acc_width from 28 to 22 to reach 210.57 MHz (+125.6 MHz) at the same 25 DSP and 469 LUT.

When an xc7s50 conv2d's unregistered DSP48E1 M-to-P path plus flat 5-level carry-chain accumulator holds Fmax to 82.07 MHz with a 12.16 ns critical path, register the DSP I/M/P stages, insert pipe_mul=2 and tree_regs=3, and shrink acc_width from 24 to 22, which cuts the path to 4.73 ns and raises Fmax to 210.57 MHz while keeping 25 DSP and 1 pixel/cycle throughput.

When a 25-DSP conv2d is feasible but timing-limited by a reduction-tree segment (4.73 ns from t2_reg through LUT3/LUT5 to a carry chain at 210.6 MHz) while tree_regs=3 and acc_width=22 are already at their legal limits, increase pipe_mul from 2 to 3 to add one fabric stage after each multiplier, moving the tree-input register closer to the adder, shortening the LUT3 route (1.22→1.04 ns) and raising Fmax to 219.8 MHz (+9.2 MHz) with LUT and DSP unchanged.
